M12 · One offline bar on every page

While the device is offline, or after two refreshes in a row fail, one amber bar shows under the top bar on every page: “You’re offline. Changes won’t save until the connection is back. Keep this page open — this bar goes away by itself.” It has no buttons: it goes away by itself when the connection is back.

It sits where Panel size’s “not saved” bar sits, outside the page’s scrolling part, so it never covers the page or the field you’re on, and it stays when you change page. It is the same amber bar as every other problem bar. (Picture 05b drew it edge to edge; this uses the shared bar built since.) Real preview screens; the bar is drawn with the app’s own styles. Amber outlines mark what’s new or changes.

1 · PC 1280×800 · Camps → Thanksgiving Camp

Today only the camp page warns, after two failed refreshes, with its own bar under the camp’s title. With M12 the one bar does it, on every page; Camps then removes its own bar (C19).

2 · Tablet 820×1180 touch · Color Belt → November Children Testing, offline

Today nothing on this page says the tablet is offline; you find out when a save fails. With M12 the bar shows as soon as the browser says it’s offline.

3 · Phone 390×844 touch and small phone 320 wide · Home, offline

On phones the bar keeps 16px from the edges and wraps onto three lines. The page scrolls under it, between it and the bottom bar.

4 · What stays · Star grading, offline with one grade waiting (PC)

Star’s own line stays (v1.005): it counts the grades still waiting, with Retry and ×. Black Belt’s grading uses the same line. Every save’s own amber bar stays too, and so does Panel size’s, under the one bar when both show.

5 · The question · Black Belt → Spring 2027 → Results, offline (PC)

Black Belt’s Results tab has its own offline bar, which also names the four things that need a connection. Print results and Download CSV are grayed while offline (Email result and Mark as sent too, on each row).

Black Belt’s Results tab: fold its own offline bar into the one bar, or keep both?

A · Fold it in (my pick)
One bar, as on every other page and as Camps does in C19. The grayed buttons say why the usual way, with a gray line next to them (v1.004); Black Belt adds that line, from a note.
+ Nothing is said twice, and the tab looks like every other page.
− A small change in Black Belt. “These results may be out of date” is no longer said in words; the one bar covers it.
B · Keep both
The one bar on top, and Black Belt’s own bar under it, as today.
+ No change in Black Belt, and its bar keeps naming the four things that need a connection.
− Two amber “You’re offline” bars on one screen.

Not pictured: when the Wi-Fi is up but the internet isn’t, the browser still says “online”, so the bar shows after two failed refreshes, about 30 seconds, with the same words, as approved. Pages that don’t refresh by themselves, such as Home, show it only when the browser says it’s offline. Behind the lock screen nothing shows.
